PROVED and verified: for every divisor d > 1 of 4Cp+1 with d ≡ -1 (mod 4C) (prime or composite), (d/p) = -1. Proof: since 4Cp ≡ -1 mod d, Jacobi gives (p/d) = (-1/d)(C/d) = -(C/d); reciprocity with d ≡ -1 (mod 4C) gives (C/d) = +1 (odd part; the 2-part is handled by d ≡ -1 mod 8), and (d/p) = (p/d) for p ≡ 1 (4). Data: 1754/1754 certificate divisors (748 prime, 1006 composite) for p ≡ 1 (4) ≤ 3000, C ≤ 60.

Mathematical check: a binary form with square discriminant factors over Q into two linear forms, and its automorphism group is infinite (e.g. xy is preserved by (x,y) ↦ (λx, y/λ)). So the lemma 'square discriminant ⇒ no infinite automorphism group' is false as stated; not a route to ES.
